scientific_limitations: The prime p is fixed; no uniformity in p is claimed.
Only the first-order normal order is proved; no explicit error term or central limit theorem is claimed.
The proof uses standard Mertens-in-progressions, Brun–Titchmarsh, and Turán–Kubilius results.
source_ids: Tenenbaum, Introduction to Analytic and Probabilistic Number Theory, 3rd ed., AMS, 2015
title: Normal order of prime-adic valuations of the divisor-sum function
